g.text: DR-01 · CU-01 Quote cart — preliminary BCE responsibilities
Client supplies codes/quantities, CNY, optional code and explicit UTC instant.
A client price has no authoritative input field.
Product and Coupon values come from the internal
Trust does not waive configuration validation.
Flow text: 1 submit; 2 check request; 3 resolve trusted Product;
4 total lines; 5 choose discount; 6 complete PriceQuote; 7 return.
FA-01 valid fixed; FA-02 valid percentage; FA-03 zero subtotal.
FE-01 invalid request; FE-02 unknown Product; FE-03 invalid Product;
FE-04 unknown Coupon; FE-05 expired; FE-06 minimum; FE-07 invalid Coupon.
All paths are read-only. Failure produces no successful PriceQuote.
Edges show communication responsibilities, not time or method calls.
